title: Verdict and Alibi
author: Jude Blackwood
blurb: Paloma Coldharbour, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
